english: Consider the vectors $\overrightarrow{a}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$, $\overrightarrow{b}=2\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{c}=-2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$. A particle starts from the origin $O$ and makes five successive straight-line moves. For $k=1,2,3,4,5$, in the $k$-th move it travels a distance of $k$ units in the direction of $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$, $\overrightarrow{c}$, $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$ respectively. If $P$ is the final position of the particle, then the value of $OP^2$ is ______.
hindi: सदिशों $\overrightarrow{a}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$, $\overrightarrow{b}=2\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{c}=-2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ पर विचार कीजिए। एक कण मूलबिन्दु $O$ से चलना प्रारम्भ करता है तथा क्रमागत पाँच सरल रेखीय चालें चलता है। $k=1,2,3,4,5$ के लिए, $k$-वीं चाल में वह क्रमशः $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$, $\overrightarrow{c}$, $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$ की दिशा में $k$ इकाई की दूरी तय करता है। यदि $P$ कण की अन्तिम स्थिति है, तो $OP^2$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $|\overrightarrow{a}|=|\overrightarrow{b}|=|\overrightarrow{c}|=3$, so a move of $k$ units along $\overrightarrow{v}$ is $k\hat{v}=\dfrac{k}{3}\overrightarrow{v}$
solution_full: A move of $k$ units in the direction of $\overrightarrow{v}$ is the displacement $k\hat{v}=\dfrac{k}{|\overrightarrow{v}|}\overrightarrow{v}=\dfrac{k}{3}\overrightarrow{v}$.
Adding (vector addition is commutative and associative): $\overrightarrow{OP}=\dfrac{5\overrightarrow{a}+7\overrightarrow{b}+3\overrightarrow{c}}{3}$.
(Check: $\overrightarrow{a},\overrightarrow{b},\overrightarrow{c}$ are mutually perpendicular, so $OP^2=5^2+7^2+3^2=83$ as well.)
originality_note: New: a walk whose step lengths grow 1,2,3,4,5 while the directions cycle through three non-unit vectors; the solver must normalise, group the steps by direction and add (way 1, a repeated process). The three vectors are hidden mutually perpendicular vectors of equal length, which makes the answer clean. Closest known: 'resultant of displacements' exercises. Different because: the cyclic directions with growing lengths must be grouped before adding.

concept_use.Basic properties of a vector: Magnitudes |a| = |b| = |c| = 3 and the unit vectors a/3, b/3, c/3 give each move's displacement; |OP|^2 from the components.
concept_use.Algebraic operations on a vector: Scalar multiples k a/3 and the sum of five displacements, grouped as (5a + 7b + 3c)/3.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, vector and point is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Made the assignment of direction to each move explicit ('for k = 1,...,5 ... respectively') and stated that every move is a straight line. Changed: added 'straight-line'.
key_step: Normalising the direction vectors and grouping the five displacements as (5a + 7b + 3c)/3.
justification: Routine chain: unit vectors, scalar multiples, grouping and addition, then a magnitude. Three or more routine steps with no insight, so Level 2, like 2026-P2-Q1 (L2).
